title: A singly linked list
description:
Complete the functions for a singly linked list of `int`s. A list is represented by its head pointer, which is `nullptr` for an empty list.

- `pushFront(head, value)` adds a node at the front.
- `size(head)` counts the nodes.
- `removeAll(head, value)` removes and deletes **every** node holding `value`, and returns how many it removed.
- `clear(head)` deletes every node and sets `head` to `nullptr`.

Use the pointer-to-pointer technique from the lesson for `removeAll`, so the head needs no special case. The tests check that nothing leaks.
hints: `pushFront` is one line: a new node whose `next` is the old head becomes the head.

In `removeAll`, keep a `Node** link` that starts at `&head`. While `*link` is not null: if its value matches, unlink and delete it **without moving `link`** (the next node has just slid into its place); otherwise move `link` to `&(*link)->next`.
